info.title: Outline Wiki MCP REST API
info.description: REST passthrough endpoints for an Outline wiki (self-hosted or cloud), siblings of the Outline MCP tools. Mint a 5-minute bearer with the mintRestBearerForCurl MCP tool, or use a permanent dashboard API key. Reads answer raw Outline JSON; the document export answers markdown.

get.description: Full-text search across Outline documents. Defaults to published documents only.

parameters.name: statusFilter
parameters.description: Statuses to include. Defaults to published only.

403.description: No Outline connection for this account, or permission denied

get.description: Documents ordered by most recent change, newest first. The time window is coarse: day, week, month or year.

parameters.name: dateFilter

get.summary: Resolve an Outline document title to its ID
get.description: Prefers an exact title match and falls back to the best partial one. ALWAYS check exactMatch: a partial match is a guess, not an answer.

get.summary: Start an async export of a collection
get.description: STARTS a server-side job and returns a fileOperation id plus state. It does NOT return the export, and every call queues another one. Poll Outline for completion.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format. An unrecognised value falls back to outline-markdown rather than erroring.

403.description: No Outline connection for this account, or permission denied

get.summary: Start an async export of the whole workspace
get.description: Same shape as the per-collection export: starts a job, returns a fileOperation id and state, and queues another export on every call.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format. An unrecognised value falls back to outline-markdown rather than erroring.

get.summary: Resolve an attachment ID to a download URL
get.description: Follows the Outline redirect to a pre-signed storage URL. That URL is time-limited and grants whoever holds it access to the file, so treat it as a credential rather than an identifier.
